pattern: chat agents miss the configured source-control language
experience: The Git UI respected the client language, but agents writing commits and PR descriptions saw only English repository examples.

setup.context: Repository conventions: conventional commits. Recent commit: fix(web): prevent duplicate messages. Default PR headings: Summary and Testing. No repository PR template.

prompt: Draft a commit message and PR title and description for preventing duplicate messages after reconnecting. Unit tests pass. Return only a JSON object with string fields commit, prTitle, and prBody. Do not run tools or publish anything.

source.scenario: Client language was passed to GitManager but not agent turns

pattern: configured English beats the request and example language
experience: Changing the client language must also update later agent-written commits and PRs.

setup.context: Recent commit: fix(web): 防止重复消息。No repository PR template.

prompt: 为修复重连后重复消息的问题拟定 commit 描述、PR 标题和描述，单元测试通过。仅返回 JSON 对象，使用字符串字段 commit、prTitle、prBody。不要调用工具或发布。

pattern: explicit user language wins over the configured default
experience: A configured Chinese default must not block an explicit request for an English contribution.
prompt: Write the commit message and PR title and description in English for a reconnect duplicate-message fix. Tests pass. Return only a JSON object with string fields commit, prTitle, prBody. Do not use tools or publish anything.

source.scenario: User override of the configured source-control language
